decision.rule: Portfolio contracts own tool semantics at the product-root capability layer. CORE supplies shared execution, model, artifact, connector, data, work and UX infrastructure but does not silently acquire portfolio-specific semantic authority. A future first-class system still requires explicit user instruction plus a superseding topology ADR/registry version.

owns: generic document/content artifact creation and transformation semantics
DOCX/PPTX/PDF format-specific semantic contracts and preservation requirements
generic non-Book writing requests and reusable written artifacts
document/file intake classification needed by these formats
OCR document extraction contract and provenance handoff
native-editor/open-in handoff policy for generated artifacts
does_not_own: Book canonical manuscript, story bible, book plan or lifecycle state
Core artifact storage implementation or global file custody
routing_rules: If output becomes a canonical Book object, BOOK owns canonical state and this portfolio provides document/render/export services through published contracts.
If the task is literary/prose evaluation or revision intelligence, PROSE owns that semantic decision and this portfolio may only materialize the resulting artifact.
Generic writing outside Book/Prose remains a product-root headless content capability.
File storage/custody remains Core infrastructure; file-content semantics remain portfolio-specific.

portfolios.data_scope: DATA module here means user-facing analysis/database/BI semantics only; shared physical persistence, system records and canonical storage remain CORE/DATA foundation authority.
owns: spreadsheet workbook/sheet/formula/table/chart semantic contracts
numerical and symbolic calculation semantics
user-facing structured-data analysis and BI transformations
analysis artifact provenance and deterministic recomputation requirements
does_not_own: Book/Learning domain records merely because they are tabular
production data migration authority without owner-specific contract
routing_rules: Domain-owned data remains owned by its domain; this portfolio may compute over an authorized projection without becoming canonical writer.
Core provides sandbox/compute/artifact/persistence primitives but cannot convert analysis output into domain-canonical state without the owning domain contract.

owns: headless software-engineering task semantics and code artifact lifecycle
build/test/static/dynamic qualification task contracts
local-model selection/use requests at the tool capability layer
software/model execution evidence and result packaging
does_not_own: Book/Learning/Prose source semantics when engineering work modifies their owned code
routing_rules: A code task modifying an owner system remains change-authorized by that owner; this portfolio supplies engineering execution semantics and evidence tooling only.
LOCALAI consumes Core model/runtime/routing infrastructure; it cannot self-promote models or override safety/resource/target qualification.

owns: research plan/query/synthesis/provenance semantics
knowledge-item promotion, citation and confidence semantics above shared storage
browser/web information-work semantics that are read/research oriented
geospatial/mapping/weather/environmental intelligence synthesis contracts
does_not_own: write/action authority in email/calendar/other external services
domain-canonical Book/Learning state simply because research informs it
routing_rules: Research may propose evidence to Book/Learning/other domains, but canonical admission remains with the receiving owner.
External information retrieval is separated from connected-account mutation/action semantics.

owns: user-intent and approval semantics for external write/actions
email/message/calendar/personal-operations action contracts
automation trigger/schedule/condition semantics at the user-capability layer
plugin/app capability registration and permission-use semantics above connector runtime
does_not_own: third-party service authority or permissions not granted by the user
silent autonomous outreach/purchases/publication without required authorization
routing_rules: Read-only external information work routes to Research & Knowledge when no account mutation is required.
Any consequential external action remains approval/permission bounded even when invoked from Chat or an automation.
Second Shift is internal infrastructure and is not the Automation product capability.

owns: image generation/editing and photo transformation semantics
video generation/assembly and media-master semantics
speech/TTS/audio generation semantics
audiobook production/assembly semantics consuming authorized Book content
image/media ingestion and region-intelligence contracts
media provenance and artifact packaging requirements
does_not_own: Book canonical text or author decisions
voice identity/rights or private media permissions not explicitly available
routing_rules: Audiobook/media generation consumes a frozen Book-owned content version; media output cannot modify Book canonical text.
Image/media artifacts referenced by Book/Learning remain media artifacts until admitted by the receiving domain through its own canonical contract.
Studios may exist as optional control surfaces, but media execution remains headless-capable and a studio does not become a first-class system by default.

cross_portfolio_invariants: Chat is the primary invocation surface; portfolios are headless capability contracts, not navigation mini-apps.
Long jobs may use Core work/background infrastructure or Second Shift when explicitly eligible, but execution infrastructure never becomes semantic owner.
All durable outputs use shared Core artifact/custody infrastructure while retaining portfolio/domain semantic provenance.
A portfolio may consume another portfolio or owner-system interface but may not write that owner's canonical state without an explicit admitted operation.
Provider/native-app adapters never become semantic owners.
Exact-SHA qualification does not transfer across reused historical implementation bytes; changed/current subjects require their own evidence.
Human, author, private, external-action, native, publication and production authority remain separately gated.
implementation_order: HEADLESS-CONTENT-ARTIFACTS-001 via SYSTEM-MASTER-DOCUMENT-TOOL-CURRENT-ADMISSION-001 because substantial preserved DOCX/PPTX/PDF implementation evidence already exists and can be selectively re-admitted rather than rebuilt.
HEADLESS-COMPUTE-DATA-001 spreadsheet contract using preserved EXCEL-QUAL research/build evidence.
HEADLESS-SOFTWARE-MODEL-001 engineering contract using preserved CODE-QUAL and Core execution infrastructure without conflating qualification with the product tool.
HEADLESS-RESEARCH-KNOWLEDGE-001 contract over Core retrieval/evidence/connector primitives.
HEADLESS-CONNECTED-ACTIONS-001 authority/approval contract over Core connector/action primitives.
HEADLESS-MEDIA-001 contract over model/artifact/provider primitives, preserving Book/media boundaries.
completion_rule: This owner-allocation obligation is complete because every P6 unresolved headless-tool module now has a non-duplicative semantic portfolio or an explicit non-portfolio disposition, no new first-class system was created, Core shared runtime remains separate from tool semantics, and one exact current-admission successor is selected.
